title: Surreal Cosmic Sphere
description: A large blue sphere dominates the composition, featuring a multi-eyed surreal face with white skin and purple floral patterns. An orange ring orbits the sphere like Saturn, with small human figures walking along its surface. The background is split between white space with radiating lines and black space filled with geometric circles and patterns.
